name: 97702 · Bend, OR
findings: ZIP 97702 (Bend) has 215 nonprofit organizations. 98 of them (46%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 74 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (21% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 97702 (Bend) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
32% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 97702 (Bend) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 46 organizations here; 49% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?

observations.title: Few religious organizations list public events
observations.text: 3 religious organizations here list public events. In similar places of this size, about 12 would.

confidence.text: Based on 12 organizations here; 49% of all organizations here have no identified type.
